body.name: Candidate bounded common-law collision certificate
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Certificate}=(G_1,G_2,M_1,M_2,p,c_x,c_y)\) with \(G_j\in\mathfrak R(H)\), \(M_j\in\mathfrak M(H,d)\), \(G_{M_j}=G_j\), \(P_{M_1}=P_{M_2}=p\), \(Q_{M_1}(c_y;c_x)\neq Q_{M_2}(c_y;c_x)\), and every latent root of either model having support at most \(B(H,d)\); rational or real-algebraic table entries are encoded by integer polynomials and isolating intervals.
